checks.rule: OOS/IS >= 0.3

checks.rule: <= 0.6 (needs >1 year)

checks.rule: <= 0.2 (fills on unobserved quotes)

checks.rule: >= 2 regimes with >= 20 trades and E[R] > 0

checks.rule: share of neighbours with positive val+test expectancy >= 0.6
